title: [PM seat] domain:skills · seat 2 — ⏳ vacant
body:
**This post is the single authoritative registration of the skills lane's SECOND seat (`domain:skills#2`).** Four-section template; the job description is versioned at `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` — ⛔ not copied here. Seat 1's post is #7623. Body **r61** (⏳ vacant: the sign-off ledger), written 2026-10-19T16:52Z by `session_014kWeosxNDsHDT6TuQHLmC1` (os-warren). r60 back to r58 (this shift's seating and rounds) and r57 (the previous shift's ledger) are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated.

## Current PM

⏳ **vacant.** `session_014kWeosxNDsHDT6TuQHLmC1` (os-warren), seated 2026-10-19T14:42Z, signed off on the maintainer's 「当前任务处理完，合并后就下班」 in that session (2026-10-19). The release marker is the shift-end brief comment stamped after this body. A successor reads this post and seats at once with `/pm-dispatch skills`. `check-handover.mjs --session=session_014kWeosxNDsHDT6TuQHLmC1 --account=os-warren` read clear (exit 0: no unreleased claim, no decision outside the inbox) before this body was written. Seat 1 (#7623) is held by `session_01HEdP5tPhqQfzwRmKDxwn85` (os-justin) and was not touched.

## Inherited ledger

- **Lane at sign-off** (objectstack, REST `labels=` AND reads; objectui 0 open `domain:skills`): `pm:queue` 1 (#24585) · `pm:dispatched` 0 held by this seat · decision box 3 (#24525 · #24591 · #24610) · `pm:blocked` 0 · `pm:on-hold` 0 · `pm:retriage` 0 · bare `finding` 0 · `tracking` 2 (#22060, #17161) · `pm:awaiting-maintainer` 1 (#24351).
- **This shift landed 1:** #24589 (ruling B) → PR #24602 `c03b17d78` (squash by the merge queue at 2026-10-19T16:49Z; Tier S; contract review PASS 6271676253, ACCEPT 6271736509, pointer 6271798508; landed by this seat through the relay).
- **Untouched, the successor's first card: #24585** (p2, `tooling`, filing gate ③ 「技能侧可选改法，立skills卡片」, triage first touch 6270321855). Not dispatched because the maintainer's sign-off word came while #24589 was in flight under the serial posture. Premise readings taken 2026-10-19T16:12Z on `origin/main` `5a871e4e4`: `references/dispatch-runbook.md` lines 140–141 read as the card quotes; the file is at its ceiling 241/241; `dispatch-gates --tier` names no path mandate (`TIER_DEFAULT` build, at-tier review before the Tier S landing); no same-day churn on the file. Readers of the shared checkout's branch name found by grep: `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` lines 729 and 891 (dev worktrees) and `.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout.sh` line 120 (`rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`, which reads `HEAD` on a detached checkout — the dev measures what the hook then does). Triage's ride-along suggestion (one PR with #24589) was refused: fold gate ① fails (different defect shape and files). This seat's own instance of the symptom: the stop hook asked for a push after the pre-dispatch fast-forward and the seat pushed a zero-diff mirror branch `claude/nice-johnson-105jjg` — the cost the card names.
- **Decision box, this shift's two cards:** #24591 (how a lane handles a card whose premise or fix lives in a repository it cannot reach; options A/B/C, recommendation B; filed on the maintainer's 「但是这一类卡片应该怎么处理也需要开决策卡」) and #24610 (new `filing-gate.md` line 27 closes a reach-less `finding` at first touch vs `triage-duties.md` line 50's 2026-09-25 p3 fold; options A/B, recommendation A; the fork the #24589 dev reported). #24525 (cloud verify-lock texts) stays in the box; the maintainer's word to this session: 「cloud 你访问不到，相关卡片不用处理」.
- **Carried from r57 (pointers, not cards under the filing gate):** non-blocking maintainer questions #23787 6207817517 · #23733 6205096053 · #23692 6205078148; the `editMode` vs `navigation.mode` (ADR-0085 §2) chat-only question; #23860's live pin 6217094606; the 「rate limit」 clause pointer 6207969413 on #23216; PR #23795 review F1–F3 (no measured `reach:`); stale 「three contract faces」 text (`record-recognisers.mjs` L113–114, `lanes/ui.md` L38, three frozen `dispatch-gates*.mjs` comments); `os-dev.md`'s report template lacks `deviations` / `line_budget` / `files_changed` (both devs this shift reported them anyway); `platform-readings.md` L171's payload path.
- **New pointers this shift (not cards):** after PR #24602, `filing-gate.md` line 21 uses `carrier:` with its definition out of file (`SKILL.md` 报告契约 line, `os-dev.md` L52–L53); the #24589 dev deepened the shared repository's history (`git fetch --deepen` to 2026-09-05, additive).

## Hot-file serial queue

None held by this seat. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` · `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` · `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`: FREE under the narrowed freeze (`instrument-discipline.md`; derivation-truth fixes only, ⛔ no new gate, row, ratchet, `--tier` mandate or constant). Every other lane file: FREE (`filing-gate.md`, `execution-duties.md`, `triage-duties.md` released at PR #24602's merge).

## Notes

- **Write paths:** content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `issue-create.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, run bare from `/home/user/objectstack` on route `dispatch` (the relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`, Actions `active`). ⛔ No MCP write. The seat-post title is written with the relay op `issue_patch`.
- **Platform facts this shift:**
  - The auto-mode classifier refused one `label-write` carrying `--assign` + `--add` + `--remove` together (`[External System Writes]`); split into two bare invocations it passed. Shape, not capability.
  - Relay runs read `queued` for minutes after their writes had landed (Actions read lag): `issue-create`, `post-stamped` and `dispatch.mjs` then exit 6 UNCONFIRMED. The remedy is to read the target, never to re-send; every such write this shift had landed.
  - `post-stamped` refuses a bare `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` beside `{{NOW}}` (the mixed rule): quoted instants are spelled `{{WAS:…}}`.
  - `git-history.mjs touch` refuses below the shallow floor; `fetch --deepen=600` surfaced every charter touch but `lanes/skills.md` and `reading-discipline.md`, read from the REST commits list instead.
  - The isolated at-tier reviewer posted its `## Contract review` record through the relay from inside this session without a `[Self-Approval]` refusal.
- **Seat error (one):** the #24525 objection was written fifteen minutes after the candidate read with no re-fetch; triage had first-touched it in between. Withdrawn the same round (6270112643).
- **Harness:** CURRENT at `de43524606` at seating; the shared checkout was fast-forwarded to `2667e240` before the dispatch and to `origin/main` again at sign-off; its mirror branch `claude/nice-johnson-105jjg` is pushed at the same sha.
- **Timers and sessions:** the patrol Routine `trig_016kzLozNzrAqDzUDR4pHvQG` and the one-shot flip point `trig_01STHbFJ9MXVq2FrHq1EkRMk` are deleted at sign-off; `subscribe_pr_activity` on #24602 ends at its merge; every dev and reviewer ran `mode:subagent`, so no cloud session exists to archive; no worktree remains beside the shared checkout.
